name: 线程级北极星指标（容器）
description: 从 Grafana 面板迁移并汉化，已转换为“我的面板”原生格式。来源：thread-polaris-container。

variables.name: cluster_id
variables.label: 集群
variables.query:
SELECT DISTINCT scope_id AS __value, 
CASE 
  WHEN c.name != '' THEN c.name
  ELSE scope_id
END AS __text
FROM data_scope 
LEFT JOIN clusters c ON scope_id  = c.id
WHERE type = 'cluster'

query.expression: histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(originx_thread_polaris_nanoseconds_bucket{container_id=~"${container_id:regex}", tid_key=~"${tid:regex}", type="cpu", cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}"}[$interval]))  by (container_id, tid, vmrange))
